name: Lake District
about: Genuinely one of the wettest parts of England, but the rain rarely stops hiking outright, just makes it muddier; best conditions are Apr–Sep.
overview: England's most popular national park — Windermere, Scafell Pike, Wordsworth's Grasmere, all packed into a compact landscape of lakes and fells.
costOverview: The Lake District runs typical for rural England — a proper pub lunch of Cumberland sausage costs a real but reasonable amount, and a Windermere lake cruise is the one classic splurge most visitors add.
monthlyWeather: cold and wet, quiet with the fells often icy
